summary: This document describes how an I2NSF Controller can provide IPsec flow protection for gateway-to-gateway and host-to-host scenarios. It defines three YANG modules for the NSF-facing interface, covering the IPsec databases (SPD, SAD, PAD) and IKEv2, so security associations can be configured and monitored with little administrator effort. It defines no new protocol.

eli5.summary: A central control room can set up secret tunnels between computers instead of someone doing it by hand at each one. This document defines the forms the control room fills in.
